claim: Actual global completed-character pullback of elliptic invariant differentials into intrinsic contact Omega, with whole-finite-chart exact scalar normalization
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing
index_scope: All i:Fin 4 for the fixed SourceTwistArithmetic318.units. Generic functorial and Weierstrass normalization lemmas retain their stated commutative-base hypotheses.
external_input_scope: No new literature input. The canonical pinned universal sheaf derivation, pullback-pushforward adjunction, affine chart and sheaf equality APIs are used.

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: Actual intrinsic universal differentials and a structure-preserving Scheme map; smooth Weierstrass discriminant for its invariant form.
obligations.constructed: The generic map consumes f≫q=p. CompletedCharacterGlobal318.over_Q supplies the literal completed-character square; published_nonsingular proves all four target discriminant units.
obligations.why_match: Derivation coefficients are compared on every target open, then the actual source universal derivation is pushed and descended. No arbitrary differential map or affine-only morphism is supplied.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: Global regular sections of intrinsic Omega on the actual complete contact source.
obligations.constructed: The actual IntrinsicGlobalFrame318.invariant is mapped by the canonical sheaf map along CompletedCharacterGlobal318.completedMap.
obligations.why_match: ContactCharacterDifferentials318.differential has type global sections of ContactIntrinsicDifferentials318.omega units, not a rational differential type.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: Every completed map and the complete finite source chart, including its branch points.
obligations.constructed: All i:Fin 4; generic map defined on the full completed schemes. Affine naturality applies to the whole source chart, and Weierstrass normalization uses both Jacobian opens.
obligations.why_match: The two Jacobian opens cover the entire affine curve by the discriminant-unit span theorem. No use of a single dense open extends a form identity.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: Agreement between canonical sheaf pullback and the actual algebra map on full affine charts.
obligations.constructed: AffineChartPullbackScalars318.map_square and affine_scalar compare actual regular functions. IntrinsicDifferentialSectionPullback318.sectionMap_naturality compares every Kaehler differential.
obligations.why_match: Equality on universal derivatives extends by additive and scalar generation. The actual completedMap finite restriction fixes the algebra map publishedToSource.

obligations.name: Identity of consumed object
obligations.required: The form normalized on the finite ring must be the restriction of the globally pulled invariant.
obligations.constructed: WeierstrassAffineInvariant318.form is the inverse of the exact intrinsic affine section equivalence applied to the actual invariant restriction; finiteForm is its genuine algebraic pullback.
obligations.why_match: form_section and finite_restrict prove both identities with no choice of unrelated frame. The final intrinsic equation rewrites the algebraic identity into the actual restricted global differential.

obligations.name: Coefficients and normalization
obligations.required: Preserve dx/(2y), the centroid translation and every coordinate scale.
obligations.constructed: The actual coordinates are xScale*(t-centroid) and yScale*z. Their derivatives and xScale=scaleUnit*yScale are checked.
obligations.why_match: After the target denominator-free 2y*omega=dx identity, cancellation uses only the actual unit yScale. The result is 2z*omega=scaleUnit*dt. Thus wherever 2z is invertible the scalar is scaleUnit/2 in front of dt/z, not its inverse.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required: Whole-open section maps, valid even where individual Jacobian coordinates vanish.
obligations.constructed: The target x-open proof uses the differentiated curve relation; the y-open proof uses its actual localization inverse. Sheaf equality joins them over the full finite chart.
obligations.why_match: Only target Jacobian inverses are used on their specified localizations. The final identity contains no inverse z, so it includes the branch locus.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.required: Control all denominator cancellations and distinguish generic formulas from regular sections.
obligations.constructed: The four target discriminants and both coordinate scales are units in the fixed rational setting; no cancellation of z is made.
obligations.why_match: The global section exists on the full normalization including infinity by its definition. The formula on the finite chart is denominator-free. No new infinity-coordinate coefficient formula is claimed.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: A concrete differential correspondence input, without unproved moduli identifications.
obligations.constructed: Four actual global intrinsic sections with exact finite normalization and a generic sheaf pullback API.
obligations.why_match: The packet does not claim their independence, a basis, nonvanishing, a Jacobian isogeny, polarization, maximal-order action, PEL identification or Kodaira-Spencer comparison.

not_claimed: linear independence or basis of the four differential sections
validation: All eleven source bodies passed bounded strict checks with debug.skipKernelTC=false. Fresh target-only endpoint and recursive axiom audit passed for 76 declarations across 11 modules, with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. No full-chain cloud replay.
